author: GamingBolt
description:
Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots and Peace Walker have been given new life thanks to Master Collection: Vol. 2, available now on Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch 1 and 2, PS5, and PC. To say they've stood the test of time would be an understatement – it's actually kind of amazing how advanced some of the systems still feel after all these decades.

As such, these tips and tricks remain relevant, whether you're revisiting the franchise or diving in for the first time.
title: Metal Gear Solid Master Collection Vol. 2 - 15 Things I Wish I Knew Before Playing

author: GamingBolt
description:
Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy is genuinely one of the best games this year. But if anything, that makes one question whether that's really enough. If you take a peek at the other best-rated titles of the year, the competition is extremely stiff. 

Asobo Studio isn't just battling to compete with other triple-A titles in the same genre, especially given its presentation and storytelling, but also against indies, spin-offs, viral co-op hits, early access titles, and so much more for attention. Unfortunately, being on Game Pass doesn't seem to be helping its discoverability.
title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy - What The Hell Happened?

author: GamingBolt
description:
It may take some time to properly draw you in, but once its hooks are in, Star Wars Zero Company proves extremely addictive throughout its 35 to 40 hours of runtime. 

Maybe the positive reception will push Bit Reactor to add on to it – heck, maybe this will convince EA to see some kind of franchise potential. Either way, it's one of the few tactical turn-based titles that doesn't try to simply copy XCOM 2 in terms of gameplay feel and flow – and is all the better for it.
title: Star Wars Zero Company - Why Are So Many GAMERS Addicted?
